item.title: Hit-and-run victim meets with New Hanover DA, speaks out for public safety
item.description: A woman who lost part of her leg in an alleged hit-and-run accident says she had a face-to-face meeting Monday with New Hanover District Attorney Jason Smith.

item.title: Pender Co. commissioners debate redrawing district maps after decade of population uptick
item.description: Pender County commissioners are debating on whether to re-draw the county’s district maps which would be implemented after the 2028 primary election.

item.title: Christian Recovery Center Inc. opens their warming facility to families
item.description: As frigid weather approaches the region Christian Recovery Center Inc is opening their doors as a warming facility. Cots with pillows and blankets are prepared for families.

item.title: Laney takes down West Brunswick 54-40
item.description: Laney girls basketball pushed themselves into 2nd in the Carolina Coast standings with a 54-40 road win against West Brunswick on Monday.

item.title: New Hanover handles North Brunswick 66-39
item.description: New Hanover boys basketball moved into sole possession of first place in the Carolina Coast standings after a 66-39 home win over North Brunswick on Monday.

item.title: Concerned residents and business owners hold informational session about Eastwood Rd overpass project
item.description: According to the North Carolina Department of Transportation, the project would consist of a 30-foot-tall overpass along Eastwood Road, replacing its intersection with Military Cutoff Road.

item.title: The New Hanover Branch of the NAACP hosts 2026 Primary Election Candidate meet and greets
item.description: The New Hanover County Chapter of the NAACP will host two public candidate meet and greets throughout the rest of January.

item.title: Man in critical condition following Emory Street shooting
item.description: Wilmington police got a ShotSpotter activation in the 800 block of Emory Street around 6 p.m. Monday.

item.title: Passenger stranded in Punta Cana after Avelo cancels final flight
item.description: Back in December, Avelo Airlines launched an international flight from Wilmington International Airport to Punta Cana with great fanfare.

item.title: WWAY’s Winning Ways January 26, 2026
item.description: Another Monday means another time to count down the top three performers from the week prior in the latest installment of Winning Ways.
